questions.q_en: In a class of 60 students, 38 passed in subject A and 52 passed in subject B. If every student passed in at least one subject, how many passed in both subjects?
questions.solution_en:
Let A represents the set of students passed in subject A and B represents the set of students passed in subject B.

Then,

n(A) = 38, n(B) = 52

Since everybody passed in at least one subject, n(A B) = 60

Using the formula,

n(A B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

60 = 38 + 52 - n(A ∩ B)

n(A ∩ B) = 90 - 60 = 30

questions.q_en: A man covers a total distance of 1560 kms via various modes of transport. He covers one-third distance via train, 220 kms by bus and rest by plane. The train costs him Rs.3 per km and plane costs him Rs.5 per km. If he spent Rs.6364 on his travel, what is the cost per km for travelling by bus:
questions.solution_en:
Distance travelled by train = (1560/3) = 520 kms

Distance travelled by bus = 220 kms

Distance travelled using plane = 1560 - 520 - 220 = 820 kms

Total expenditure on travelling by bus = 6364 - (520 X 3) - (820 X 5) = Rs.704

Cost per km for travelling by bus = 704/220 = Rs.3.20 per km

questions.q_en: If length of portion of straight line 18x + ky = 180 intercepted between axis is 5√13 unit, then find the value of 'k'.

Given equation of line: 18x + ky = 180

Intercept form of equation of line: (18x/180) + (ky/180) = 1

(x/10) + [y/(180/k)] = 1

After comparing the above equation with standard intercept form of a libe: x/a + y/b = 1

a = 10, b = 180/k

Length of portion of straight line intercepted between axis = √(a2 + b2)

5√13 = √[102 + (180/k)2]

325 - 100 = (180/k)2

152 = (180/k)2

15 = 180/k

k = 180/15

k = 12

questions.q_en: How many numbers between 1 and 1000 are divisible by 3,5 and 7 and have even sum of digits?
questions.solution_en:
For a number to be divisible by 3,5 and 7, it should be divisible by LCM (3,5,7) = 105

=> Numbers between 1 and 1000 divisible by 105 are (105,210,315,420,525,630,735,840 and 945).

Out of these, only 5 have an even sum of digits (105, 420, 525, 840 and 945)

questions.solution_en:
In the right-angled triangle, out of two sides that are containing the right angle, one works as the base and the other works as the height.

Area = (1/2) x Base x height

60 = (1/2) x 15 x height

Height = 120/15 = 8 cm

questions.q_en: Bike A and bike B run a race of 80 km on a circular track of length 1200 m. Both complete one round in 300 sec and 360 sec, respectively. After how much time from the start will the Bike A meet Bike B for the last time?
questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Bike A to complete 80 km or 80000 m = (300/1200) x 80000 = 20000 sec

So, the required answer will be less than 20000 sec.

Speed of Bike A = 1200/300 = 4 m/sec

Speed of Bike B = 1200/360 = 10/3 m/sec

Relative speed = 4 - (10/3) = 2/3 m/sec

Time taken by them to meet first time at the track anywhere = 1200/ (2/3) = 1800 sec

So, the required answer will be the multiple of 1800 that is close to 20000, and that is 19800.

Therefore, after 19800 sec or 5.5 hours from the start Bike A meet Bike B for the last time.

questions.q_en:
For triangles, which statements are true?

Statements:

(a) Sum of interior angles is 180°.

(b) All interior angles can't be equal.

(c) Can have at most one obtuse angle.

(d) Sum of two sides may or may not be equal to the third side.
questions.solution_en:
(a) True.

(b) False (an equilateral triangle has all angles equal).

(c) True (a triangle can have at most one obtuse angle).

(d) False (the sum of any two sides of a triangle must be greater than the third side).

Option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: How many numbers which are smaller than 945 but greater than 360 are neither divisible by 4 nor by 9?
questions.solution_en:
Numbers which are not divisible by both 4 and 9 = numbers not divisible by 4 + numbers not divisible by 9 - numbers not divisible by LCM of 4 and 9

LCM of 4 and 9 = 36

Now, total numbers between 360 and 945 = 584

We find the numbers among these 584 numbers which are divisible by 4, 9 and 36.

Numbers divisible by 4 = 364, 368 .., 944, i.e., there are 146 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 9 = 369, 378 .., 936, i.e., there are 64 numbers.

Numbers divisible by 36 = 396, 432, .., 936, i.e., there are 16 numbers.

So, numbers divisible by both 4 and 9 = 146 + 64 - 16 = 194

Hence, numbers not divisible by both 4 and 9 = 584 - 194 = 390 numbers

questions.q_en: Ratio of one internal angle of a regular polygon to the one external angle of the same polygon is 3 : 1, then find the number of sides in the regular polygon.
questions.solution_en:
Sum of one interior angle and one external angle = 180°

According to the question,

(3 + 1) = 4 units = 180°

1 unit = 45°

We know that,

each external angle = 360/n

45 = 360/n

n = 8

questions.solution_en:
Time taken by Shane to complete 220 m = 220/ (36 x 5/18) = 22 sec

Time taken by Robin to complete 220 m = 220/ (24 x 5/18) = 33 sec

Required time = LCM of 22 and 33 = 66 seconds
